whenToUse: It can be pressed only after conditions are met, such as accepting terms or filling required fields.
It's hard to guess why it's blocked.
Keyboard and screen reader users also need the reason.
whenNotToUse: Showing errors after a press would work better (use an error summary).
It can never be pressed for lack of permission (hide it or explain the permission).
The reason is already clear on screen.

alternatives.name: Error Summary
alternatives.reason: Gathering fields to fix after a press.

accessibility: Use aria-disabled instead of disabled so it can take focus, with the reason read through aria-describedby.
Pressing it announces the reason again with role="alert" and highlights it with color and weight.
Once the conditions are met, the reason disappears and the button works right away.
The faded button keeps its text contrast.
